data.one_liner: Runs code in a Dart isolate with bidirectional stream communication.
data.what_it_does: Provides a runner to launch a top‑level function in a separate isolate. It exposes streams to send data to the isolate and receive data back, handling lifecycle and disposal.
use_when: You need to offload heavy computation to a background isolate
You require real‑time two‑way communication between UI and isolate
avoid_when: Simple async tasks that don't need an isolate
You need platform‑specific APIs that isolates can't access
strengths: Bidirectional streams make continuous data exchange easy
weaknesses: Only works with top‑level or static functions
No code generation or advanced state management features

alternatives.name: async
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic isolate utilities and stream helpers without a dedicated runner class
